liam_support: Escalating Heliotrope onboarding - activation blocked. Ticket #H-3312
liam_support: Symptoms: admin gets stuck on org setup. SAML assertion returns `invalid_response` and our SCIM sync fails intermittently. They retried and hit our rate limits (429).
olivia_support: Confirmed in logs. After ~180 automated retries they hit `seat_create` errors `quota_exceeded`. We paused retries to avoid noisy alerts.
emma_cs: Assigning to me — I'll own comms and renewal risk. Renewal in ~21d; if unresolved in 48h we escalate to account execs.
raj_engineer: Quick triage: token exchange edge-case + SCIM role map race. I can push a patch in ~6-8h if we prioritize; meantime we can do a manual SCIM sync and one-time invites as a workaround.
olivia_support: I can generate manual invites and temporarily lift quota for 24h for Heliotrope. Need a short runbook + customer-facing note.
emma_cs: Please add a one-line incident summary I can send: impact, workaround, ETA. I'll draft the email and schedule a check-in for tomorrow.
sophia_cs_manager: +1 on exec escalation trigger. If not resolved by T+48h, start renewal-engagement play (exec intro + credits). Also capture VOC for post-mortem.
raj_engineer: Kicking off canary deploy now, will post status. oncall-bot: Incident H-3312 created -> severity: P2; assignees: raj_engineer, liam_support, emma_cs.
emma_cs: Thanks — I'll prep FAQ and a short apology note (no product blame). Will share draft here before sending.
liam_support: Update: customer accepted manual invites and can continue onboarding with manual seats for now. Call scheduled 10:30am PT. :thumbsup:
